note: Realistic animal models (Dave 6 Nov 2026: aim for photorealism; design/realistic_animals_plan.md, src/client/animal_view.gd _make_model). A species row here whose scene exists is drawn from that rigged, animated scene instead of the code-built body; no row or a missing file keeps the code body. Row: scene (res:// path of a .glb/.fbx/.tscn), scale, yaw_deg (turn so the animal faces -Z), walk_mps and run_mps (ground speeds the walk and run clips were made at), stride_m (metres per footstep), clips {state number or 'walk'/'run': clip name}; states 0 graze, 1 hop, 2 flee, 3 alert, 10 warn, 11 charge, 12 recover, 16 the jaw-pop warning (bears; falls back to 10). Example: "bear": {"scene": "res://assets/animals/bear/bear.glb", "scale": 1.0, "yaw_deg": 180, "walk_mps": 1.3, "run_mps": 9.0, "stride_m": 1.1, "clips": {"0": "Eat", "3": "Idle", "10": "Roar", "11": "Run", "12": "Idle", "walk": "Walk", "run": "Run"}}. clip_prefix (optional) is put before every clip name; without it a clip is found by its name after the armature ('Armature|Idle' answers 'Idle'). The model files are bought (WildMesh 3D Ultimate 3D Animal Pack, Dave 6 Nov 2026) and are NOT in git (/assets/animals/ is ignored): copy them from the pack into assets/animals/<kind>/ on a build machine. length_m: the model is scaled so its longest side is this long (any file units). materials: [{match, albedo} or {match, hide: true}] colour textures set in code, first matching entry per surface (match '' = the rest). length_m values: design/wildmesh_scale_table.md (real adult length, nose to tail tip). Species added 7 Nov (deer, moose, boar, wolf, fox, rabbit): yaw, clip speeds and material matches are first guesses from the bear; the shot runner --shot-animals row checks them. pack (optional): the model's folder inside the bought pack; tools/install_animal_models.py copies it into the scene's folder (no .blend: headless import cannot read it). size_clip (optional): size and ground the model by its bones in that clip's first frame, for a file whose imported pose is not standing. bounds: mesh sizes by the skinned mesh instead of the bones. young_model (optional): a young animal of this species is drawn from this model at its own size (keys laid over the row like a variant) instead of the adult shrunk to half. flock_of [min, max] (optional): one record is a flock of that many birds built from the model, spread over spread_m, set sink_m into the surface. flat_share (optional, default 0.5): a clip is refused as flat below this share of the standing height; lower it for an upright animal that bends low to eat. bone_offsets (optional): {bone: [x, y, z] degrees in the bone's own axes} turned after every clip (src/client/bone_offsets.gd), to correct a pose the clips hold. clip_loop (optional): {role: [t0, t1, blend_s]} loops that window of the role's clip, its last blend_s seconds eased back to the first pose (tools/find_loop.gd finds the window). gait (optional): {role: {period_s, bones {bone: [phase, swing degrees, axis]}}} builds a looping clip for that role from the model's own bones (_gait_clip). sink_share (flock rows): sink by that share of the bird's height in its graze clip. gait (optional): {role: {period_s, bones {bone: [phase, swing degrees, axis]}}} builds a looping clip for that role from the model's own bones (_gait_clip). sink_share (flock rows): sink by that share of the bird's height in its graze clip. shine_color and shine (0 to 3, optional): eye shine in the player's held torchlight on the model's eye surfaces (docs/design/EYE_SHINE_AND_WET.md). tail_motion (optional): {period_s, when rest|alert|flies, bones {bone: [phase, swing degrees, axis]}} swings tail bones over every clip: a dog's wag at rest, a cat's flick when alert, a swish against flies in the warm months (docs/design/TAIL_MOTION.md). ear_motion (optional): {left, right, swivel_axis, flatten_axis, swivel_deg, flatten_deg} turns the ears toward a player within 20 m and lays them back when the animal warns or charges (docs/design/EAR_AND_BREATH.md). breath (optional): {bone, per_min, swell, long_axis} swells the chest bone at the species' resting breath rate, faster after a run (docs/design/EAR_AND_BREATH.md). look (optional): {bones [neck ... head], max_deg, mode glance|track, range_m, hold_s} turns the head toward the player over the clip (docs/design/HEAD_TRACKING.md). state_poses (optional): {state: {bones {bone: [x, y, z] degrees}, waves {bone: [phase, swing, axis]}, period_s}} lays a bone-built pose over the clip for a state the file has no clip for (docs/design/POSED_STATES.md). hop (optional): {walk|run: {bound_m, arc_m}} a hopping animal bounds on an arc, one hop clip per bound (docs/design/HOP_ARC.md). clips.sleep and wake_clip (optional): the clip played while the animal is bedded down (the server's rest rule, worked out on the client) and the get-up clip played as it wakes; state_poses -1 is a sleep pose for a file with no lying clip (docs/design/ANIMAL_SLEEP.md). herd (optional, true): grazing herd mates face roughly the same way, stay 2 m apart on screen and look up together (docs/design/HERD_CLIENT.md). feet (optional): [[upper, lower, end], ...] one two-bone chain per leg; with foot_ik on, each foot reaches the ground under it (docs/design/FOOTFALL.md). stalk (optional): {states, pose {bones}, clip, rate, freeze_s} crouches and creeps in those states and freezes when prey looks up; pounce: {clip, arc_m} a leap on the attack (docs/design/STALK_POUNCE.md, flag stalk_fx). flight (optional): {takeoff, flap, glide, land, flap_s, glide_s, beat_hz, bob_m} how a bird looks in the air (state 15): take-off and landing once, flapping and gliding in turns at its wingbeat (docs/design/BIRD_FLIGHT.md). season_tint (optional): {spring, summer, autumn, winter: colour} multiplies the coat by the season (docs/design/COAT_SHADER.md, flag season_coats).

bear.note: WildMesh BrownBear (Realistic Animals/BrownBear/SK_Bear.fbx, textures in its Textures folder): 7508 triangles, 35 bones, 81 clips; faces +Z, so yaw 180. Alert stands up on its hind legs; warn is the angry breathing stance; charge sprints. Jaw-pop (state 16, Steve #600): Attack_IdleAngry_01_Low, a low angry swat. The black bear's file has no such clip: it falls back to its warning pose.

goblin.note: Goblins (Dave 7 Nov 2026, docs/GOBLINS.md). Sized by mesh height: height_m plus a bell-shaped roll of up to height_variation_m, per animal id. variants are laid over this row, one per goblin by id: Skritch Ragtooth and Rukz the Scavenger, whose clip names differ. The .glb files are committed (made by Dave in Meshy, not the bought pack). Facing (yaw_deg 180, as the bear) is to be checked on the PC.

deer.note: WildMesh Deer (Realistic Animals/Deer/SK_Deer.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 113 clips. Alert stands breathing, head up. Seven looks picked by id (variants): four stags (deer, buck, red deer, second-rig stag) and three hinds (doe, doe second rig, hind), each with its own clips. Checked 7 Nov 2026.

variants.note: Hind (second rig): body texture alpha is not a cut-out (opaque)
Stag (second rig): body texture alpha is not a cut-out (opaque)

moose.note: WildMesh Moose (Realistic Animals/Moose/SK_Moose.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 99 clips. Body texture is 4096: set its import size limit to 2048 (art budget). Swim clip (8 Nov 2026): its file has no swim clip: the slow walk, mostly under water. gait_fallback swim: a hand-made paddling walk with the neck and head lifted out of the water; rename to gait to use it instead of the slow walk (axes a first guess until a creature check).

boar.note: WildMesh WildBoar (Realistic Animals/WildBoar/SK_WildBoar.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 84 clips. Warn barks.

wolf.note: WildMesh Wolf (Realistic Animals/Wolf/SK_Wolf.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 70 clips. Idle is a howl, so alert and recover stand in Idle_Breathing (creature check, 7 Nov 2026).

fox.note: WildMesh Fox (Realistic Animals/Fox/SK_Fox.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 51 clips. T_Fox_Fur is the small fur-card texture.

rabbit.note: WildMesh Rabbit (Realistic Animals/Rabbit/SK_Rabbit.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 32 clips.

horse.note: WildMesh Horse (Realistic Animals/Horse/SK_Horse.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 54 clips, 1094 bones (heavy). Wild horses: the saddle is hidden (hide entry).

donkey.note: WildMesh Donkey_1 (Realistic Animals/Donkey_1/SK_Donkey.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 54 clips, 185 MB: the same clip set as the horse is assumed (same count, same saddles); a 'no clip' log line says otherwise. The light Donkey folder (4.6 MB, 12 clips) is the fallback if this one is too heavy. Saddle hidden.

variants.note: Dark donkey (Realistic Animals/Donkey): its own clips.

lynx.note: WildMesh Lynx (Realistic Animals/Lynx/SK_Lynx.fbx, textures in its Textures folder). 95 clips; units are metres. Fur cards are the M_lynx_cards surface.

black_bear.note: WildMesh BlackBear (Realistic Animals/BlackBear/SK_BlackBear.fbx). 136 clips; units are centimetres (rescaled by length_m). Jaw-pop (state 16, Steve #600): its file has no clip, so state_poses builds one over its warning clip: head and neck low, jaw open and popping, a forepaw stamping (axes a first guess until a check).

elk.note: WildMesh Elk (Realistic Animals/Elk/SK_Elk.fbx). 58 clips; antler surface is called Chifre. Body texture may be 4096: set its import size limit to 2048 like the moose. Clips checked with tools/creature_check.gd (7 Nov 2026): Idle grazes head down; Food_Eating_01_Wolf lays it flat; the file has two clips called Walk, one static and one shrinking the rig to a hundredth, so the walk is Walk_2.

bighorn.note: WildMesh Bighorn Sheep (Realistic Animals/BighornSheep/SK_BighornSheep.fbx). 114 clips; units are centimetres. Idle_Breathing lies down, so alert and recover stand in Idle (creature check, 7 Nov 2026).

mountain_goat.note: WildMesh Mountain Goat (Realistic Animals/MountainGoat/SK_MountainGoat.fbx). 116 clips; units are centimetres. Horn surface is called MountainGoat_Antle.

beaver.note: WildMesh Beaver (Realistic Animals/Beaver/SK_Beaver.fbx). 20 clips; units are centimetres. No graze clip: Idle_2 stands in. Swim clip (8 Nov 2026): its file has no swim clip: the forward walk paddles. gait_fallback swim: a hand-made swim (hind feet paddling in turn, front legs held still, tail sculling side to side, head up); rename to gait to use it instead of the walk (axes a first guess until a creature check).

chamois.note: WildMesh Chamois male (Realistic Animals/ChamoisMale/SK_ChamoisMale.fbx). Checked 7 Nov 2026: Idle_3 grazes head down, Alert stands head up; clips are in place.

mink.note: WildMesh American Mink (Realistic Animals/AmericanMink/SK_AmericanMink.fbx). Checked 7 Nov 2026: the file has no looping walk or run, only start clips; starttrot_fwd_01 and startsprint_fwd_01 loop as walk and run. Alert stands up on its hind legs. clip_loop (8 Nov 2026, Dave: give it a walk): its walk loops starttrot_fwd_01 from 0.133 to 0.600 s and its run startsprint_fwd_01 from 0.183 to 0.483 s, the windows tools/find_loop.gd found with the closest ends (7 and 12 degrees per bone), eased together over the last 0.12 and 0.1 s. gait_fallback: a hand-made walk (four-beat) and run (bound) from its own bones, kept ready; rename it to gait to use it in place of the clip_loop walk and run (the axes are a first guess until a creature check).

crow.note: WildMesh Crow (Realistic Animals/Crow/SK_Crow.fbx). Its imported pose has the wings spread: sized by its bones in the Walk clip (size_clip). Checked 7 Nov 2026. Its feathers reach about twice past its bones, so length_m 0.25 (bone length) draws a crow about 0.45 m long. bone_offsets (8 Nov 2026, Dave: pose its skeleton): the body is tipped up 25 degrees and the chest 15 more, and both wings turned down and back over every clip, so it stands upright with folded wings instead of hunched with them half raised.

goose.note: WildMesh Goose (Realistic Animals/Goose/SK_Goose.fbx). Swim clip (8 Nov 2026): SwimMoveMedium from its own swim clips.

young_model.note: WildMesh Calf (Realistic Animals/Calf/SK_Calf.fbx): the cow's young.

goat.note: WildMesh Goat (Realistic Animals/Goat/SK_Goat.fbx). T_Goat.png's alpha is nearly all zero (not a cut-out): its material entry is opaque, or the goat is invisible.

dog.note: WildMesh Dog (Realistic Animals/Labrador/SK_Labrador.fbx). Companion states (docs/design/DOG_COMPANION_CLIPS.md, Steve #606): 10 barks, 18 sits, 19 lies down; the bloodhound holds the end of its sit and lie transitions as loops.

duck.note: WildMesh Duck (Realistic Animals/Duck/SK_Duck.fbx). One wire record is a flock: flock_of birds built from the model, spread_m apart, sink_m low in the water (_make_model_flock). Swims, takes off and flies in state 15. sink_m 0.15 puts the paddling legs under the water line (the swim clips stand on the feet). sink_share 0.45 (8 Nov 2026): it sits into the water by 45% of its height in its swim pose (the paddling legs plus about a third of the body), worked out from its own bounds; sink_m stays as the fallback.

puma.note: WildMesh Puma (Realistic Animals/Puma/SK_Puma.fbx). Imported crouched: sized by its standing 'idle pose' (size_clip); length_m 2.0 is nose to tail tip. Checked 7 Nov 2026.

pronghorn.note: WildMesh Pronghorn (Realistic Animals/Pronghorn/SK_Pronghorn.fbx). Same rig as the elk: Idle grazes head down, the real walk is Walk_2. Checked 7 Nov 2026.

warthog.note: WildMesh Warthog (Realistic Animals/Warthog/SK_Warthog.fbx). Imported mid-run: sized by its Idle (size_clip). GrazingOnSpotA2IdleThreat drops onto its haunches, so warn stands in Idle_Breathing. Checked 7 Nov 2026.

hyena.note: WildMesh Hyena (Realistic Animals/Hyena/SK_Hyena.fbx). Laughs when it warns. Checked 7 Nov 2026.

guineafowl.note: WildMesh Guineafowl (Realistic Animals/Guineafowl/SK_Guineafowl.fbx). Imported with its wings spread: sized by its Idle (size_clip). Checked 7 Nov 2026.

honey_badger.note: WildMesh Honey badger (Realistic Animals/HoneyBadger/SK_HoneyBadger.fbx). Checked 7 Nov 2026.

mammoth.note: WildMesh Mammoth (Realistic Animals/Mammoth/SK_Mammoth.fbx). Trumpets when it warns. Checked 7 Nov 2026.
